# MediaRow

A horizontal card for one show or movie: small poster, title, a meta line and optional watched progress, used for Continue Watching and list views.

`TVTracker.MediaRow` · Media

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.MediaRow title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.MediaRow" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (MediaRowProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `string` |  |
| `meta` | `string` | e.g. "Next: S2 · E5 · Chapter Five" |
| `image` | `string` |  |
| `watched` | `number` | Episodes watched / total; shows a progress bar and count when total > 0. |
| `total` | `number` |  |
| `href` | `string` | Renders the row as a link. |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  |
